_comment: Every slot passes through lib/media.ts, which withholds an image unless FIVE things are true at once: a non-empty path, permission.granted === true, publish !== false, tier !== 'C', and alt text in at least one locale. A slot missing any one of them resolves to null and the component renders its designed placeholder instead.
_comment_permission: permission.granted is a SEPARATE field from path on purpose. Having the file and having the right to publish it are two different things, and the first is never evidence of the second. scripts/check-publish-gate.mjs fails the build (exit 1) on any slot that has a path without a recorded permission, so the two are always set together.
_comment_alt: Alt text is part of the gate rather than a nicety: an image that cannot be described has not been understood well enough to publish. Intake form section 5 also requires that people in a photo be named and that event photos carry dates, neither portrait here contains anyone but the subject.

slots._comment_cutout: THE PATH IS THE DERIVED CUTOUT, NOT THE SUPPLIED JPEG. The original photograph is a studio shot on a white seamless; on this page's near-black ground that white rendered as a bright disc with a hard edge, reading as a sticker rather than a portrait. scripts/build-portrait-cutout.mjs removes the seamless with a soft alpha ramp and writes the -cutout.png beside it. The SUPPLIED FILE IS UNTOUCHED and still sits at /assets/sanae-rakik-portrait.jpg, the cutout is a derived asset, so re-running the script reproduces it and the permission recorded below still describes the same photograph of the same person. No retouching of the subject is performed: only the background is removed.

slots._comment: Intake form section 5 requires a professional horizontal image at no less than 1920px for a full-bleed backdrop. Neither supplied file reaches that width (1206px), and upscaling would produce exactly the 'صور غير احترافية أو منخفضة الجودة' the same section forbids. The slot stays empty and the hero renders its built backdrop, which is a permanent floor rather than a placeholder awaiting deletion.

organisationId must match a row id in data/positions.json for getOrganisationLogo() to find it. A third-party logo needs the organisation's own permission, not the subject's, that is why this stays closed even though her own photographs are cleared.

_comment_never: Nothing is added here that the subject does not hold the rights to. Event and conference photography is usually the photographer's copyright regardless of who appears in it, so a file arriving by message is not by itself a permission.
